description: This PHP source file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Client_ServerIntrospection, which wraps XML-RPC system.* introspection methods, allowing clients to query server methods and signatures via XML-RPC calls.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Client_ServerIntrospection
classes.description: A class that wraps XML-RPC system.* introspection methods like listing methods and retrieving method signatures.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the server proxy for system methods using the client.

methods.name: getSignatureForEachMethod
methods.description: Retrieves signatures for all methods, attempting multicall support first, then falling back to looping.

methods.name: getSignatureForEachMethodByMulticall
methods.description: Attempts to get all method signatures via a single multicall request.

methods.name: getSignatureForEachMethodByLooping
methods.description: Retrieves each method's signature by sequentially calling system.methodSignature.

methods.name: getMethodSignature
methods.description: Fetches the signature of a specific method with error handling.

methods.name: listMethods
methods.description: Lists all available methods on the server.
